headline: Public hearings on variance and special exception requests for projects at 79 Gilson Road, 5 Roby Street, and 352-354 Main Street.
summary: Requests include a proposed dog park near a wetland on Pine Street, a five-unit apartment building on Main Street, and porch repairs on Stockton Drive. The request for 48 Buckmeadow Road was postponed to this meeting.
items: Minor setback encroachment for building addition at 79 Gilson Road
Dog park site work within wetland buffer at Pine Street
Filling, grading, and replanting within wetland buffer at 5 Roby Street
Structural porch and deck repairs within wetland buffer at 5 Stockton Drive
Multiple variances, including land area and driveway width, at 48 Buckmeadow Road
Setback variance for building addition and porch expansion at 4 Fireside Circle
Variances for land area, open space, and floor area ratio to build a 5-unit building at 352-354 Main Street
Floor area ratio variance at 15 and 19 Atherton Avenue
Second reading of proposed bylaw amendments
location: 3rd floor auditorium at Nashua City Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH

ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT 
DECEMBER 8, 2026 
 
The following is to be published on ROP November 29, 2026 under 
the Seal of the City of Nashua, Public Notice Format 65 MP 51. 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua 
Zoning Board of Adjustment will occur on Tuesday, December 8, 
2026, at 6:30 p.m. in the 3 rd floor auditorium at Nashua City 
Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH. Members of the public can submit 
their comments via email to (zb@nashuanh.gov) or by mail (please 
make sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4:00 p.m. 
on December 7, 2026. Letters should be addressed to City of 
Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. 
Plans can be viewed online starting December 3, 2 026, at 
www.nashuanh.gov. 
 
Consent Agenda 
 
1. Justin & Dustin Gerstenfield (Owners & Applicants) 79 Gilson 
Road (Sheet D Lot 266) requesting Special Exception from 
Land Use Section 190-16,E. (3) to permit a minor encroachment 
– 1.6 feet into a 20 -foot side setback , for a building 
addition. Monumented survey provided. R30, Ward 5. 
 
Regular Agenda 
 
2. NAS MXU MINCO LLC (Applicant) City of Nashua (Owner) L Pine 
Street (Sheet 77 Lot 5) requesting Special Exception from 
Land Use Code Section 190-112 to permit the construction of 
site improvements associated with a proposed dog park within 
a 75-foot primary wetland buffer. RB & GI Zones, Ward 4. 
 
3. Eric Newman (Owner & Applicant) 5 Roby Street  (Sheet 126 
Lots 23) requesting Special Exception from Land Use Code 
Section 190-112 to permit filling, grading, and replanting 
within a 75-foot primary wetland buffer. RA Zone, Ward 6. 
 
4. Richard C. Berman, Trustee  (Owner & Applicant) 5 Stockton 
Drive (Sheet F Lot 32) requesting Special Exception from 
Land Use Code Section 190 -112 to permit structural repairs 
to an existing porch/deck within a 40 -foot wetland buffer. 
R18 Zone, Ward 1. 
 
 
Planning & Zoning 589-3090 
Fax 589-3119 
WEB www.nashuanh.gov
5. Miguel Bisono (Owner & Applicant) 48 Buckmeadow Road (Sheet 
C Lot 216) requesting the following Variances from Land Use 
Code Section 190-16, Table 16-3: 1) minimum land area, 67,949 
sq. ft existing – 160,000 sq. ft required for 4 dwellings, 
2) minimum open space, 75% required, 66% proposed; 3) from 
Land Use Code Section 190 -17,B for more than 1 princi ple 
structure on a lot – 4 proposed; 4) from Land Use Code 
Section 190 -17,E for cumulative driveway width, 24 feet 
permitted – 41 feet proposed across 2 driveways. R40 Zone, 
Ward 5.  
[POSTPONED PER APPLICANT REQUEST TO 12/8/2026] 
 
6. Brian & Katye Standberg, Trustees (Owners & Applicants) 4 
Fireside Circle (Sheet G Lot 648) requesting Variance from 
Land Use Section 190 -16, Table 16 -3 for a setback 
encroachment – 10.5-feet into a 25 -foot side setback, for 
the construction of a building addition and expansion of  a 
covered farmers porch. R40, Ward 2. 
 
7. ZR Development, LLC (Applicant) JMS Realty Corp. (Owner) 
352-354 Main Street (Sheet 8 Lot 67) requesting Variance 
from Land Use Code Section 190-16, Table 16-3 for 1) minimum 
land area, 7,405 sqft existing – 31,115 sqft required, 2) 
minimum open space, 29% proposed – 35% required, and 3) from 
maximum floor area ratio, 0.6 proposed – 0.5 permitted, to 
construct a 2-story, 5-unit multi-family building. RB Zone, 
Ward 7.  
 
8. Vernon C. Shelby & Estate of Samuela Shelby & Philip Simard 
(Owners) 15 & 19 Atherton Avenue (Sheet 46 Lots 22 & 23) 
requesting Variance from Land Use Code Section 190-16, Table 
16-3 for floor area ratio, 50% allowed – 70% proposed. RA & 
RC Zones, Ward 3. 
 
 
 
OTHER BUSINESS: 
 
1. Review of upcoming agenda to determine proposals of        
     regional impact. 
 
2. Approval of Minutes for previous hearings/meetings. 
 
3. Review of Bylaws. Second reading of proposed amendments
